features.title: Project toolbar
features.desc: Filter Active, Add from Clipboard, Add Project, Hide Sidebar.

features.title: Project search
features.desc: Filter the project list by name or folder path.

features.title: Project list
features.desc: Each project shows its name, path, open-task count, and a live running indicator. Right-click for Open in Finder / Terminal / Delete.

features.title: Tasks
features.desc: Lists tasks for the selected project. New Task opens the create sheet; Quick Task starts one instantly.

features.title: Task actions
features.desc: Edit description, notes, copy, archive/complete, and a watch bell for notifications.

features.title: Window & pane controls
features.desc: New / prev / next window, split (H/V), rotate, zoom, close, pop out to Terminal.app.

features.title: Quick Commands
features.desc: The lightning button opens one-click saved shell commands (project or global).

features.title: Git status bar
features.desc: Branch, staged / unstaged / untracked counts, ahead-behind, Show changed files, Revert All.

features.title: Terminal
features.desc: Live, tmux-backed terminal for the selected task. Sessions survive app restarts.

features.title: App launcher
features.desc: Buttons that open supporting macOS apps inside the project directory.
